data.title: Use local time for invoice comparisons

data.head: 36ad2f0
data.subject: Use local time for invoice comparisons

data.caused_by: Use local time for invoice comparisons

data.summary:
Fixed shopkit/billing.py.

Root cause: `now_utc()` was changed to `datetime.now()`, which returns a naive local datetime despite the function’s UTC-aware contract. Restoring `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` ensures invoice due dates and default comparisons remain timezone-aware.

Verified: `41 passed`.
data.diff:
diff --git a/shopkit/billing.py b/shopkit/billing.py
index 6ee01dd..fa1e5f4 100644
--- a/shopkit/billing.py
+++ b/shopkit/billing.py
@@ -26,7 +26,7 @@ class Invoice:
 
 def now_utc() -> datetime:
     """Current time, always timezone-aware."""
-    return datetime.now()
+    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 
 
 def days_until_due(invoice: Invoice, now: datetime | None = None) -> int:
